about-text-1: I am a final year Master's student at FER, where I completed my undergraduate studies with magna cum laude honors. I come from Međimurje, and spent my early childhood in Slovenia where I was born.
about-text-2: Currently, I'm persuing a diploma in field of Computer Engineering. academic work revolves around computer security and solving optimization problems. Professionally, I’m interested in backend systems and embedded development.
about-text-3: I am diligent and resourceful, and consider myself a friendly and open person. I am constantly looking for new challenges and eagerly embrace opportunities.
hobbies-text-1: Besides watching series and movies (especially sitcoms and fantasy), I often play pub quizzes (and have tried organizing them). I love to travel, and I also enjoy playing guitar.
hobbies-text-2: I tutor high school and elementary school students in STEM subjects.
